abstract: The clinicopathological features of 26 pure endodermal sinus tumors (EST) and for embryonal carcinomas of the ovary occurring in children under age 15 years in Britain over the period 1962-1978 are described. Endodermal sinus tumor has shown a significant increase (P less than 0.001) over the 17-year period considered. Compared to controls, EST and embryonal carcinoma have not shown an association with the use of hormones or tranquilizers during pregnancy, with radiological investigations, or with infections in pregnancy though the numbers of cases studied were very small. The histological and immunohistological features of EST and embryonal carcinoma in children do not differ substantially from the descriptions of these tumors in adolescents and adults. Using the FIGO staging classification 23% were Stage I tumors; 3% were Stage II; 70% were Stage III; and 3% were Stage IV neoplasms. The 5-year actuarial survival rate was 39% among 26 cases of EST and 1 of the 4 cases of embryonal carcinoma also survived for 5 years. Clinical stage at diagnosis was the only indicator of prognosis, but the introduction of polychemotherapy (vincristine, actinomycin-D, cyclophosphamide/cis-platinum, vincristine, bleomycin) resulted in long-term survival in 7 of 7 cases of EST (2 Stage I and 5 Stage III) and 1 of 2 cases of embryonal carcinoma (Stage III). Radiotherapy appears to have little role to play in the treatment of pure EST or embryonal carcinoma.
abstract_ja: 1962年から1978年の期間に英国で診断された15歳未満の小児における純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍(EST)26例と卵巣胎児性癌の臨床病理学的特徴を記述する。卵黄嚢腫瘍は、観察期間中に有意な増加(P<0.001)を示した。対照と比較して、EST および胎児性癌は、妊娠中のホルモン剤や精神安定剤の使用、放射線学的検査、妊娠中の感染との関連は認められなかったが、症例数は非常に少なかった。小児のESTおよび胎児性癌の組織学的・免疫組織学的特徴は、思春期および成人の記述と大きく異なるところはない。FIGO病期分類では、23%が病期I、3%が病期II、70%が病期III、3%が病期IVの腫瘍であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍26例の生命表法による5年生存率は39%、胎児性癌4例中1例も5年生存した。診断時の臨床病期が予後を示す唯一の指標であったが、多剤化学療法(ビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド/シスプラチン、ビンクリスチン、ブレオマイシン)の導入により、卵黄嚢腫瘍7例中7例(病期I 2例、病期III 5例)および胎児性癌2例中1例(病期III)で長期生存が得られた。純粋型ESTや胎児性癌において、放射線療法の役割は小さいと思われる。
